notes: every chart: chart._ssr false, env.node off, 400 x 300; the first setOption at T0.
events in order at T0 + t; a sample is zr.animation.update() and a read of what the case's probes name.

cases.note: a step line ('start', step: true) whose values change: the stepped points tween, __points beside them, the symbols follow __points; 1000 ms linear

step 'middle' with an area, on the default update timing (300 ms cubicInOut): a category added at the end (a '+' point from where the new datum sits in the old coordinates) and the values moved; the stacked-on points stepped against the line's
step 'end' on a vertical base axis (a category y axis, the value x): the turn runs along y
a step line with connectNulls: the nulls filtered out before the turn -- the current and the next stepped arrays differ in length when a null moves (fillArray pads or cuts the current)
two stacked step lines with areas: the upper one's stacked-on points are the lower one's, stepped against its own line; then a second update 400 ms in, from where the first stopped

a value y axis with minor ticks, minor split lines, split areas and an end name, a category x axis with split areas and a middle name: new data doubles the y extent and the grid moves -- every leaf whose anid the old group had tweens from the old one (500 ms cubicInOut, the axis model's update timing); a minor tick of a new interval appears at once

a horizontal value x axis with minor ticks and minor split lines and a start name, a category y axis with a rotated middle name (nameRotate 30); a dataZoom-free merge that changes the categories (the category labels and areas move by their values) and the x extent; the axes' own update timing 800 ms linear
an inverse category x axis with split areas on fractional insets: each band's x is the previous x + width, which past the small coordinates is not the tick's own; the grid moves (500 ms cubicInOut)

a repeated glyph turned by symbolRotate 30 pops in and turns from 0 (createOrUpdateRepeatSymbols' rotation); the ITEM model's animationDuration (2000), animationEasing ('linear') and animationDelay (300) over the series' (800 ms cubicOut); a row whose item says animation: false is set; a single glyph is turned at once and only scales
symbolClip: the bundle's clip grows on the item model's timing (a row's own animationDuration 1500 and delay 200; the series' 1000 linear)
